environment.thread_policy: one CPU affinity per worker; Arrow/OMP/BLAS thread limits = 1
environment.clock: perf_counter_ns monotonic wall; process and child CPU via getrusage
environment.memory_policy: whole-tree peak unavailable; process peaks diagnostic only
environment.native_sampling: upstream NumberStats uses random_device; no seed control; chosen schemes retained per leaf in archive index

contract.delimiter: LF byte only; delimiter excluded from value; CR retained
contract.blank_lines: one empty string per LF-delimited blank record
contract.final_newline: terminal LF terminates the last record; no phantom extra row
contract.preprocessing: none; BOM, NUL, whitespace, Unicode forms and order preserved

dataset.artifact_identity: full raw Thunderbird log member extracted from the MD5-verified official Zenodo archive

manifest.semantics: all maximal ASCII letter runs; case-sensitive substring; ordered row IDs

cpu_scope: parent process only; excludes native worker CPU
cache_policy: bounded decoded Arrow blocks; LRU for archive v2; no result cache
timing: cold includes QuerySession open and first filter; warm times one filter
OS_cache: uncontrolled; fresh QuerySession and native worker per trial
peak_memory: native worker VmHWM per session; parent peak not isolated
